notes.title: Content update
notes.content:
So a truck with content turned over on our street.

We present to you our big update in which we have included:
1) Added 4 more maps with two modes (night and day).
2) Added a lot of new clothes for skiers.
3) Significantly redesigned skier gameplay. We have been calibrating and improving skiing for a long time.
4) Added 2 arcade elements.

I hope you will like it! Enjoy skiing!

notes.title: Fixpatch!
FIX CONTROLLER
notes.content:
[h3]Dear gamers![/h3]
We have released a patch that fixes controllers. Forgive me for taking so long to make it, but we succeeded and now everything is working stably. We've also improved performance. Thank you, I hope you enjoy the game.
---
[i]Looking ahead, we have carefully collected all your requests and feedback and started to make a big update for the game. We will increase the amount of content and add new features in order to diversify the gameplay.[/i]

notes.title: PATCH BUGS
notes.content:
[h3]Dear gamers: Thank you for reporting bugs that were hiding in the snowdrifts. We keep fighting them.[/h3]ːsteamthumbsupː

Today’s patch fixes an issue with exiting level after the match, floating through terrain on the night maps and hanging in the air on start. Our snowstorm team(the coders) successfully defeated these bugs. 

We still have some work to do. Some players could not play the game on SteamVR controllers; we are developing the best solution. Also, we are almost at the finish line of dividing single and multiplayer modes and implementing the free ride mode.

notes.title: New Year — new demo!
notes.content:
Last few months we’ve been working on Skiing VR and we’d like to show you the whole new demo of the game. We collected all of your feedback and made the game more immersive, stable and, of course, now it looks prettier

We developed new models of objects, updated textures, added some eye-candy things like snow trails under your ski and little snowflakes all around.

Try the new demo now and show us your [b]support by adding Skiing VR to your wishlist[/b]!

[h2]What to expect in the full game?[/h2]

[list]
[*] Real skiing mechanics in VR 
[*] Epic slopes which you can ride in the daytime or night
[*] Different game modes: relaxing free ride, challenging time and AI race, classic score mode
[*] Challenge your friends on hillsides and find out who is the best skier
[*] And yes, deers. We have some!
[/list]

notes.title: Hey guys! Catch a major new update for our demo!
notes.content:
ːsteamthisːWe took into account the wishes of our fans and released a major update for our demo. Now our demo version works correctly on most VR devices.ːsteamthisː

Detailed list of changes:
[b]1. Added fans.
2. Optimization of visual effects.
3. Added forest detailing.
4. Improved track shape.
5. Added support for most VR devices.[/b]

[u][b]Check out our new control system![/b][/u]ːsteamsaltyː

notes.title: Hey! Hey! Hey! Good news everyone!
notes.content:
Skiing VR is based on the mechanics of real ski movement, by which the player uses stick-like ski poles and head-bends to guide the movement. The intuitive and realistic controls offer a maximum gameplay experience and brings a huge share of excitement. Partake in cooperative competitions and play in 4 unique modes of play. Hit the slope and collect coins as you play and be careful to avoid any obstacles on your path. Bonuses are awarded for brilliant skiing. Overtake your opponents and show off your skiing skills as you gain momentum and go for the win. 
 
Skiing VR is suitable to players of all ages and experience levels and offers a fun and casually, cleverly designed skiing experience in a competitive environment. This is your opportunity to experience the frosty sensation of competitive skiing without breaking your legs! 
 
KEY FEATURES:

- Realistic VR experience
- 4 gameplay modes
- Compete against worldwide players
- Stunning visuals
- Intuitive, realistic controls
